shortDescription: Guitar goes out of tune quickly after bends, tremolo use, or temperature changes.

q_tuning_trigger.title: When Does It Go Out of Tune?
q_tuning_trigger.question: What action triggers the guitar to slip out of tune?
q_tuning_trigger.measurementGuide: Tune accurately to pitch, then perform the suspected action and check the tuner readout.

options.label: After string bends (note returns FLAT, then goes sharp if tugged)
options.description: Ping or 'plink' sound heard at the headstock while tuning or bending.

options.label: Immediately on brand new strings
options.description: Strings keep slipping flat continuously after being newly installed.

options.label: After using the vibrato / tremolo bar
options.description: Diving the whammy bar leaves strings flat; pulling up leaves them sharp.

nut_slot_friction_binding.title: String Binding in Nut Slot (Friction Pinch)
rankedCauses: Nut slots are too tight for string gauge (90% of all electric tuning issues)
No lubrication in bone or plastic nut slots
fixOrder: Color inside the nut slot with a standard #2 graphite pencil (graphite is an excellent dry lubricant).
Or apply a tiny dab of dedicated guitar nut lubricant (e.g. Big Bends Nut Sauce).
Ensure string angle back to tuning post is clean without binding against slot edges.
measurementsRequired: Check for audible 'plink' or sudden jump when tuning.
nut_slot_friction_binding.whenToConsultLuthier: If nut slots need widening for heavier strings with professional nut files.

unstretched_strings_poor_winding.title: Strings Not Stretched or Loose Post Wraps
rankedCauses: New strings still have elasticity in core wire and winding wraps around tuning posts
Too many sloppy overlapping winds on the tuner peg
fixOrder: Gently grab each string around the 12th fret and pull upwards 1-2 inches with moderate pressure.
Retune to pitch and repeat until pulling the string no longer causes the pitch to drop.
On non-locking tuners, ensure 2-3 neat winds without overlaps.
measurementsRequired: Tuner stability after 3 firm string stretches.

tremolo_knife_edge_and_friction.title: Tremolo Bridge Pivot Friction or Claw Imbalance
rankedCauses: Strat 2-point or Floyd Rose knife edges have burrs or lack lubrication at post contact points
String tree on headstock causing string drag after bar dive
fixOrder: Lubricate tremolo pivot knife-edges with synthetic lubricant.
Lubricate underside of string tree guides on headstock.
Ensure tremolo claw screws are balanced so bridge returns to consistent rest position.
measurementsRequired: Measure bridge float gap above body before and after tremolo dive.
tremolo_knife_edge_and_friction.whenToConsultLuthier: If knife edges are deeply pitted and require filing or bridge replacement.
